note: EB3-A/B/C/D (plan U7-2). ONE declaration of the CI layers, read by scripts/eb3-ci-required.mjs. This file is the Required-ness claim; the workflows are the implementation. A job declared here that no workflow provides is CI_REQUIRED_JOB_ABSENT; a workflow job nobody declared is CI_JOB_UNDECLARED. Neither direction may be silent: an undeclared job can be deleted by the next tidy-up, and a declared-but-absent job is a merge gate that does not exist. Layers are reusable workflows called ONLY by the aggregate (mustRunOn=workflow_call): one caller, one run, one result — a standalone pull_request trigger would double-run every layer and expose it to GitHub's pending-run cancellation inside a shared concurrency group. Each layer's `legs` name the CONCRETE invocation it must perform (cmd + required flags + forbidden flags), not a word to look for: a leg satisfied by an echo, a step name, a shell comment or a weaker flag set is not a leg. `hostFree` declares whether the layer may list a suite that resolves the pinned host checkout; eb3-ci-required refuses a host-dependent suite in a hostFree layer (CI_HOST_DEPENDENT_SUITE_IN_HOST_FREE_LAYER). DATED 2026-11-15 (TINF M6): every node:test leg is now dispatched by `scripts/dispatch-tests.mjs --leg <dispatch_id> --run`. The workflow no longer enumerates a single test file, so the twin list eb3-ci-required graded is gone; a leg declares its population ONCE as `suites[]` (an explicit subset of a larger discovered area) or `areas[]` (the whole area, so a new suite there is collected without editing anything), and the dispatcher refuses an unknown/untracked suite, an empty area or an empty argv. deferral.note: THE DEFERRED TIER. Census runs only when the PR is NOT a draft and NOT labelled `ci-defer-full`: a draft PR is the L1 tier (cheap layers only), and the label is an explicit extra lever for a ready PR. The ci-census caller may carry exactly `callerIf` and nothing else; the deferred job may never be named ci-required. The head frozen for review must be marked ready (or have the label removed) and run with the full aggregate green.

It lives in ci-census for the M7-A reason: this job provisions and builds the pinned host, and M7B1_REQUIRE_PINNED_HOST=1 makes an absent host a hard failure instead of the declared refusal the suite otherwise grades (without the flag the suite still proves INSTRUMENT_ERROR reason=HOST_ABSENT, so there is no green path through a missing host). `--test-timeout=1200000` and a 15-minute step bound: one boot plus three real arms, measured locally (evidence dev/agent-workflow/evidence/m7b1-observation-window-20261116/).
